Attached: 1 image

Endurain is an open-source, self-hosted fitness tracking service that gives you more control over your activity data.

It supports GPX, TCX and FIT imports, with integrations for Strava and Garmin Connect. Deploy it with Docker and keep your fitness data on your own server.

The project is currently in a temporary feature freeze while developers focus on improving its foundation and stability.


More details: https://digitalescapetools.com/tools/tool.html?id=endurain
